ROW.COLUMN: One method of laundering money through insurance products is for a customer to initiate a large policy with "dirty" money and then soon thereafter borrow against the policy, receiving "clean" funds from the insurance company. For this scenario large policies are those that have a large cash value that may be borrowed against.

There are three rules in this scenario. Primary Rule retrieves those customer ids which are engaged in activity of interest. It also stores customer records for Supporting Data. Sub Rule 1 is for Insurance Policy Supporting Data. It fetches all policies which are responsible for generating alerts. And Sub Rule 2 stores all engaged transaction in activity of interest that is all 'LOAN-TAKEN' transaction within the Lookback Period for policies, which comes from Sub Rule 1. One remaining Insurance Profile Supporting Data is done by using 'Match Augmentation Rule' as 'Match Data Binding' method. As per 'Technical Require Document' of this scenario, out of six, only four ML Standard Scoring Bindings (Aggregate monetary amount in base currency for all matched transactions, Count of all matched transactions, Effective risk level of the focal entity, Percentage of high-risk matched transactions in all matched transactions) are applies to this scenario. First three are calculated at Primary Rule level, and remaining last one is calculated at Sub Rule 2 level.

with Trxn_Data as ( SELECT ipc.CUST_INTRL_ID, ipc.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID, max(it.TRXN_DT) as Latest_Borrow_Dt, max(coalesce(sm_start.LAST_CASH_VALUE_BASE_AM,0)) as Cash_Value_Start FROM @BUSINESS@.INSURANCE_POLICY_CUST ipc inner join @BUSINESS@.INSURANCE_TRXN it on ipc.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID = it.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID --cash value at the end of the month that precedes the beginning of Lookback Period left outer join (select ipsm.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID, ipsm.LAST_CASH_VALUE_BASE_AM, ipsm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT from @BUSINESS@.INSURANCE_POLICY_SMRY_MNTH ipsm where ipsm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT > (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED' || (@Lookback+2)) and ipsm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT < (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED' || (@Lookback+1)) ) sm_start on ipc.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID = sm_start.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID WHERE it.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'LOAN-TAKEN' and ipc.CUST_NSRNC_PLCY_ROLE_CD = 'OWNR' --Lookback Period and it.TRXN_DT > (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED' || (@Lookback +1)) /*1 is added in lookback to avoid the cases when 1st day of month is Saturday on Sunday*/ and it.TRXN_DT <= (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1') GROUP BY ipc.CUST_INTRL_ID, ipc.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID )
SELECT m.CUST_SEQ_ID, m.CUST_INTRL_ID, min(m.Policy_Lag) as Min_Policy_Lag, max(m.Agg_Borrow_Am) as Max_Agg_Borrow_Am, max(m.Agg_Borrow_Pt) as Max_Agg_Borrow_Pt, sum(m.Agg_Borrow_Am) as Tot_Borrow_Trxn_Am, --Scoring Binding sum(m.Agg_Borrow_Ct) as Tot_Borrow_Trxn_Ct, --Scoring Binding max(m.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB) as Cust_Efctv_Risk_Nb --Scoring Binding
FROM
(SELECT c.CUST_SEQ_ID, c.CUST_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB, ip.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID, ip.NSRNC_PLCY_ISSUE_DT, td.Latest_Borrow_Dt, td.Cash_Value_Start, (f_to_number(f_date_to_char(td.Latest_Borrow_Dt, 'J')) - f_to_number(f_date_to_char(ip.NSRNC_PLCY_ISSUE_DT, 'J'))) Policy_Lag, sum(coalesce(ipsm.NSRNC_LOAN_TAKEN_AM,0)) Agg_Borrow_Am, case when td.Cash_Value_Start > 0 then (sum(coalesce(ipsm.NSRNC_LOAN_TAKEN_CT,0))/td.Cash_Value_Start) * 100 else 999999999.99 end as Agg_Borrow_Pt, sum(coalesce(ipsm.NSRNC_LOAN_TAKEN_CT,0)) as Agg_Borrow_Ct
FROM Trxn_Data td, @BUSINESS@.CUST c, @BUSINESS@.INSURANCE_POLICY ip, @BUSINESS@.INSURANCE_PRODUCT p, @BUSINESS@.INSURANCE_POLICY_SMRY_MNTH ipsm WHERE td.CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID and td.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID = ip.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID and ip.NSRNC_PRDCT_INTRL_ID = p.NSRNC_PRDCT_INTRL_ID and ip.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID = ipsm.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID --Included Insurance Types and (@All_Insurance_Type_Fl = 'Y' OR p.NSRNC_TYPE_CD in (@Incl_Insurance_Type_Lst)) --Included Premium Types and p.PREM_TYPE_CD in (@Incl_Premium_Type_Lst) --Lookback Period and ipsm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT > (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED' || (@Lookback +1)) /*1 is added in lookback to avoid the cases when 1st day of month is Saturday on Sunday*/ and ipsm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT <= (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1') --Exclude Exempt Customer and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) --Alert generation conditions and ( (c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and add_months(td.Latest_Borrow_Dt, -@HR_Max_New_Policy_Period) <= ip.NSRNC_PLCY_ISSUE_DT ) or (c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and add_months(td.Latest_Borrow_Dt, -@RR_Max_New_Policy_Period) <= ip.NSRNC_PLCY_ISSUE_DT ) ) GROUP BY c.CUST_SEQ_ID, c.CUST_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB, ip.NSRNC_PLCY_INTRL_ID, ip.NSRNC_PLCY_ISSUE_DT, td.Latest_Borrow_Dt, td.Cash_Value_Start ) m WHERE --Alert generation conditions ( (m.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and m.Agg_Borrow_Am >= @HR_Min_Borrow_Am and m.Agg_Borrow_Pt >= @HR_Min_Borrow_Pt ) or (m.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and m.Agg_Borrow_Am >= @RR_Min_Borrow_Am and m.Agg_Borrow_Pt >= @RR_Min_Borrow_Pt ) ) GROUP BY m.CUST_SEQ_ID, m.CUST_INTRL_ID HAVING -- Frequency Period max(m.Latest_Borrow_Dt) > (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED' || (@Frequency+1)) and max(m.Latest_Borrow_Dt) <= (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.MNTH_BNDRY_CD = 'ED1')
